verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at loops.so/llms.txt (HTTP 200, structured product summary), and several doc snippets come from it, including migration guides and Content API pages. Loops also runs a dedicated /agents docs section (API, CLI, MCP, skills, LMX, workflows, migrate) and a machine-readable openapi.json, so the agent-oriented docs side is well covered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and per-page markdown docs (docs.md returned 404).
